tools.description:
Start an Access session and obtain its four-digit session_number, or end the current session.
The public inputSchema is a permissive transport envelope (names only); all conditions below are enforced by the server with compact structured errors.
Arguments (field? means optional; Type? means nullable): action:"start"|"end".
The server rejects unknown fields, invalid types, values, bounds and alternatives.
Runtime rules: start issues a four-digit session_number; end ends the shared access cycle.
Returns: IssuerStartReceipt{ok:true,session_number:string} | IssuerEndReceipt{ok:true} | RoleFailure{ok:false,provider_identity?:union,error:RoleErrorBody,required_action?:union,message_hash?:union,text?:union,return_to_chat?:union}.
Errors: input_validation_failed is a structured public error; see exact strict output schema fallback for error shapes/codes.

inputSchema.description: Transport envelope only. Every named argument is advisory; server validates strict types, required fields, action restrictions and bounds and returns bounded structured errors.

tools.name: session
